description: Defines the absl::exponential_distribution class template for generating exponential distribution random numbers, including parameter handling, distribution logic, and I/O operators.

classes.name: exponential_distribution
classes.description: A template class for generating exponential distribution random numbers with configurable lambda parameter.

classes.name: exponential_distribution::param_type
